purpose: Machine-validatable quality contract for consequential Intelligent Graph relationships. Extends the existing graph overlay; does not create authority or a second graph store.
source_of_truth_rule: Relationships remain a derived semantic overlay on canonical objects. Persistence location does not promote truth.

owner_scope_contract.cross_owner_rule: DERIVED_SHARED requires explicit consent_ref and must not expose a private canonical source object.

provenance_contract.rule: Every edge is a claim and requires non-empty provenance.
provenance_contract.verified_rule: VERIFIED additionally requires at least one evidence_ref.

temporal_contract.rule: valid_from <= valid_until when both are present; null valid_until means open-ended.
temporal_contract.historical_truth_rule: Expired or superseded relationships must not be returned as current.

supersession_contract.rule: supersedes_relationship_id may be null; if present it must not equal relationship_id and must resolve to a prior relationship.

applicability_contract.rule: Retrieval does not imply applicability; UNKNOWN must stay UNKNOWN.

migration_boundary: This contract does not require immediate persistence-column expansion. A schema change is justified only after representation analysis proves canonical JSON/provenance fields cannot safely carry the required semantics.

ratification.basis: Director directive 2026-09-30 16:56 PDT: "get the intelligent graph fully done... 10 out of 10... take the lead... just go" — delegated execution authority for the full chain, recorded by Naya 4
ratification.scope: Machine contract governing Graph V2 relationship semantics (fields, epistemic states, statuses, temporal/supersession/applicability/consent contracts, authority boundary). Does not redesign the graph, create authority, or authorize CONNECT/A→B→C/two-owner.
